research.title: Robustness of Intent Classification to Conversational Paraphrases
bullets: Designed supervisor-guided experiments comparing intent classifiers on original utterances and meaning-preserving paraphrases, controlling training partitions and label distributions.
Evaluated lexical and contextual representations under paraphrase variation, categorizing prediction changes by negation, word order, and conversational phrasing.

research.title: Annotation Budget Allocation for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Planned supervised comparisons of random and uncertainty-based sentence selection with supervisor guidance, holding annotation budgets and evaluation splits constant.
Implemented selection loops and examined entity-level precision and recall, separating errors involving rare entity types from boundary mismatches.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sentiment Classification Representations
bullets: Implemented sentiment classifiers using term-frequency features, averaged word embeddings, and a recurrent encoder under a shared preprocessing pipeline.
Compared classification performance across review lengths and inspected misclassifications involving negation, mixed sentiment, and vocabulary absent from training data.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Frequency and Graph-Based Ranking
bullets: Implemented sentence extraction using term-frequency scoring and graph-based ranking, applying identical tokenization and summary length constraints across methods.
Compared summaries using reference overlap and manual inspection, documenting differences in redundancy, topic coverage, and dependence on sentence position.
